title: Planet Tweaks V2.7.9 NOVA TITAN 🪐 — Restored Classic Custom Action Loop & Seamless In-App Auto-Updater
releaseNotes: Restored Classic Custom Action Loop: Reverted to the ultra-clean, simple 2-key and delay preset macro setup for instant setup and zero confusion. Seamless In-App Auto-Updater: Fixed installer file lock conflicts when updating from within the app, ensuring automatic clean binary replacement and instant relaunch. Version bump to 2.7.9 across Classic and Nova AI editions.
